rounds.text: GSP Crop Science demonstrates superior capital efficiency, consistently outperforming its sector benchmarks with an ROE of 16.6% [E13] and an ROCE of 19.0% [E12], both of which significantly exceed the sector medians [E9, E10, E65]. This operational excellence is further validated by a strong momentum profile, evidenced by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E45] and a high Sharpe ratio of 3.34 [E48]. The company is successfully pivoting toward higher profitability, as shown by a 67% compounded profit growth over the last three years [E18] and an accelerating 25% growth in the trailing twelve months [E19]. Furthermore, management is actively strengthening the balance sheet by reducing total borrowings from Rs 296 Cr to Rs 262 Cr [E33]. Conceded: the stock trades at a premium valuation with a P/E of 27.88x against a sector benchmark of 20.77x [E6], and institutional money flow is currently negative [E38]. Despite these headwinds, the company benefits from a sector tailwind [E61, E62] and a rules-based screen score of 80/100 [E52], suggesting that the market is currently rewarding the company's recent earnings acceleration [E56].
